suites.coverage: external verifier self-tests and repository boundary

Release workspace tests. The 394 explicit opt-in tests cover Vulkan rendering and resource lifetime; native Wallpaper Engine model, puppet, texture, shader, lighting, prelighting, scene zoom, effect space, descriptor pool, shadow, volume and dynamic-layer fixtures; Drawing GPU and artifact-frame checks; installed fonts, isolated audio and media; CPU reference profiles; and a manual freeze-frame benchmark. These require separate fixture, device or live-runtime qualification and are not counted as CI passes.
